name: Acid Glove
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

Your hand is coated with a thin layer of acid, which you can use to damage creatures. The spell deals 1d6 acid damage upon a successful melee touch attack.
